I, Gayantha Karunatilake, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed fora public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of thatAct.

The allotments of land from ' A' to 'E' in total extent of about 0.8413Hectare depicted in the Advance Tracing No. KE/YTY/2017/44 anddated 19.03.2017 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in theVillage of Ganepalla in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 135,Ganepalla in Minor Division of Kithulgal Palatha in the DivisionalSecretary's Division of Yatiyantota in Kegalle District in theSabaragamuwa Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ - Ganepalla Estate(Upper Division) – Extent:0.2326 HectareNorth: Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division); East: Ganepalla Estate(Upper Division) and Lot B (Road); South: Lot B (Road); West: LotB (Road) and Stream.

02. Lot ‘B’ - Ganepalla Estate(Upper Division) – Extent:0.0703 HectareNorth: Lot A, Ganepalla Estate (Upper division) and Lot C;East: Lot A, Ganepalla Estate (Upper division) and Lots C and E;South: Lot C, Ganepalla Estate (Upper division), Lots E and D;West: Lot D, Stream and Lot A.

03. Lot ‘C’ - Ganepalla Estate(Upper Division) – Extent:0.1869 HectareNorth: Lot B(Road) and Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division);East: Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division); South: Ganepalla Estate(Upper Division) and Lot B(Road); West: Lot B(Road).
04. Lot ‘D’ - Ganepalla Estate(Upper Division) – Extent:0.2959 HectareNorth and East: Lot B(Road); South:Lot B(Road) and Stream;West: Stream.
05. Lot ‘E’ - Ganepalla Estate(Upper Division) – Extent:0.0556 HectareNorth: Lot B(Road); East: Ganepalla Estate (Upper division);South: Stream; West: Lot B(Road).
Gayantha Karunatilake,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
